title: get_or_create advances state on cache hit (no-op INSERT)
description: chat.rs::get_or_create calls advance_state() unconditionally even when INSERT OR IGNORE was a no-op (chat already existed). Every call to get_or_create on an existing chat produces a spurious Chat/changes delta, causing clients to poll for nothing. Fix: check conn.changes() after INSERT; only advance_state if affected > 0.
